FROM_SQL: ${CDR_SCHEMA}.DM DM INNER JOIN ${CDR_SCHEMA}.RAND RAND ON RAND.PROJECT = DM.PROJECT AND RAND.SUBJECT = DM.SUBJECT

FROM_SQL: ${CDR_SCHEMA}.BE BE LEFT JOIN ${CDR_SCHEMA}.SV SV ON SV.PROJECT = BE.PROJECT AND SV.SUBJECT = BE.SUBJECT AND SV.INSTANCENAME = BE.INSTANCENAME AND (upper(BE.INSTANCENAME) NOT LIKE 'UNSCHEDULED%' OR to_date(SV.VISDAT) = to_date(BE.BEDAT))
COMMENTS: Sample collection (BEL log, BET tumor tissue) left joined to SV; unscheduled visits also match on date

FROM_SQL: ${CDR_SCHEMA}.PC PC LEFT JOIN ${CDR_SCHEMA}.SV SV ON SV.PROJECT = PC.PROJECT AND SV.SUBJECT = PC.SUBJECT AND SV.INSTANCENAME = PC.INSTANCENAME AND (upper(PC.INSTANCENAME) NOT LIKE 'UNSCHEDULED%' OR to_date(SV.VISDAT) = to_date(PC.PCDAT))
COMMENTS: Pharmacokinetics samples left joined to SV
